findings: Together AI's self-serve fine-tuning is SFT + DPO only; no reinforcement learning.
Qwen3-VL is absent from the catalog; Qwen2.5-VL and Qwen2-VL 72B are inference-only.
Vision-language fine-tuning is limited to Qwen3.5/Qwen3.6/Qwen3.8 and Gemma/Llama VLMs.
No cost is quotable because the RL stage (the project's goal) cannot run on this platform.
